ZIRCONIUM_HYPERKALEMIA_AUTO_FULL_REVIEW..snippet: DIALIZE-Outcomes NCT04847232: Fishbane S et al. Kidney Int 2025;108:686-694. Hyperkalaemia on chronic haemodialysis, sodium zirconium cyclosilicate (n=1349) vs placebo (n=1341). Primary cardiac event composite: 119/1349 (8.8%) vs 119/1341 (8.9%), no significant difference. Per-arm counts + denominators AACT-verified.
